remediation.reason: Attempt-1 independent review found RR-002 immediate integrated-artifact enforcement and RR-003 validation-evidence provenance gaps

findings.summary: Integrated delegated task commits can mutate prior-attempt artifacts and still pass implementation certification; detection is deferred to history checking.
Validation remediation evidence remains forgeable because its digest marker and formatted failure entries are self-attested rather than linked to a deterministically verifiable failed gate.
